plan.objective: Run Windows 3.11 for Workgroups from /app/isos/win311.img in QEMU, leaving it running in the background at the Windows 3.11 desktop with VNC on :1 (5901), nginx on port 80 for web access, snapshot mode enabled, and programmatic keyboard input configured.
plan.current_focus: Inspect available environment and launch/repair QEMU + nginx with receipt-backed evidence.
implementation_approach: Discover installed tools and any existing launch scripts/configuration.

Start QEMU in snapshot mode with VNC :1 and a keyboard-control-capable interface (e.g. QMP/HMP on a local socket or stdio redirected to a socket) so keystrokes can be injected programmatically beyond VNC.
Start nginx on port 80 serving a simple web interface or status page for remote access.
Use receipts to verify the QEMU process, VNC listener, nginx listener, and desktop reachability.
If the VM is not at the desktop, use programmatic input to drive it there and capture evidence.
validation_strategy: Confirm QEMU command line includes /app/isos/win311.img and snapshot mode.
Confirm a control channel exists for programmatic keyboard input.
Verify the VM reaches the Windows 3.11 desktop via VNC or other measurable evidence.
Keep the VM running in the background after verification.
verification_test_strategy: Use raw_bash to inspect processes, sockets, and launch artifacts.
Use probe_service if needed for service readiness.
Use receipts instead of rerunning equivalent checks.
Only finalize when all required evidence is receipt-backed.
known_bad_behavior: nginx installed but not listening on port 80.
Keyboard input only via manual VNC interaction.
Smoke checks that do not prove the desktop is reached.
evidence_gaps: No receipt-backed evidence yet for a running QEMU process.
No receipt-backed evidence yet for VNC on 5901.
No receipt-backed evidence yet for nginx on 80.
No receipt-backed evidence yet for desktop reachability.
No receipt-backed evidence yet for programmatic keyboard input configuration.
risks: QEMU or nginx may not be installed.
Windows 3.11 may require manual boot interaction if not already configured.
Need to avoid mutating the base image; snapshot mode is mandatory.
next_steps: Collect receipts for listeners and process state.
Drive VM to desktop if necessary and verify.
finalization_requirements: Receipt-backed evidence of the QEMU launch command and process state.
Receipt-backed evidence that VNC is listening on port 5901.
Receipt-backed evidence that nginx is listening on port 80.
Receipt-backed evidence that the VM reached the Windows 3.11 desktop.
Receipt-backed evidence that programmatic keyboard input is configured and usable.

actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'PATH=%s\n' "$PATH"
command -v qemu-system-i386 || true
command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || true
command -v nginx || true
command -v ss || true
command -v netstat || true
command -v python3 || true
ls -l /app/isos/win311.img || true
ps -ef | grep -E 'qemu|nginx' | grep -v grep || true
